items.title: Ball State Turns Attention to UMass as the Cardinals Prepare for Midweek MACtion.
items.summary: MUNCIE, Ind. -- Ball State football enters its first midweek MACtion matchup of the season, looking to carry its recent success into Wednesday night's road contest at UMass. Head coach Mike Uremovich, Keldric Luster and Amier Glenn joined the media Monday morning to discuss the upcoming road trip.

items.title: Cardinals and Minutemen Open MAC Competition During Midweek #MACtion, Nov. 4 on ESPNU
items.summary: MUNCIE, Ind. – As announced Monday by the Mid-American Conference and ESPN, the Ball State Cardinals will kick off at Massachusetts on Wednesday, Nov. 4 at 7:00 p.m. ET, when the Cardinals travel to face the Minutemen.

items.title: Ball State Stamps Homecoming Victory Versus the Hornets
items.summary: MUNCIE, Ind. – The Ball State football team returned to Scheumann Stadium for its 2026 homecoming celebration, battling Sacramento State to a 37-17 victory in front of a crowd of 12,518.

items.title: Lewis Finds New Rhythm at Ball State After Long Road Back
items.summary: MUNCIE, Ind. -- For Ball State linebacker Cincear Lewis, finding his rhythm means more than making plays on the football field. When Lewis isn't brining opposing ball carriers to the turf, he trades his helmet for a bow.

items.title: FOOTBALL GAMEDAY: Ball State Homecoming Celebration Welcomes Sacramento State to Muncie
Luster Named Earl Campbell Tyler Rose Award National Player of the Week Honorable Mention for Week 7
items.summary: MUNCIE, Ind. – A day after earning his second nod as the Mid-American Conference Offensive Player of the Week, Ball State quarterback Keldric Luster has earned honorable mention distinction for the Earl Campbell Tyler Rose National Player of the Week Award.

items.title: Cardinals Carry Renewed Confidence into Homecoming Matchup
items.summary: MUNCIE, Ind. -- Ball State football returns home this week looking to build on the momentum of its first Mid-American Conference win of the season as it prepares to host Sacramento State. Head coach Mike Uremovich, along with Gavin Forsha and Chris Hood, met with the media Monday morning to discuss the Cardinals' recent win and upcoming matchup.

items.title: Luster Named MAC Offensive Player of the Week, Ball State's First Two-Time Winner Since Carson Steele
items.summary: MUNCIE, Ind. – Keldric Luster broke the Ball State passing record for completion percentage by a QB with at least 30 attempts, passing 27-of-32 for 256 yards and three touchdowns as the Cardinals got past Stony Brook, 41-17 last Saturday. items.title: Cardinals Take First Road Win Since 2024 in Overtime Thriller at Bowling Green
items.summary: BOWLING GREEN, Ohio – The Ball State football team captured its first road victory since Oct. 12, 2024, taking a 32-31 win in overtime over Bowling Green inside Doyt Perry Stadium.

items.title: TOGETHER (Ball State Sports Link Docuseries): Episode 4
items.summary: MUNCIE, Ind. -- For the second straight year, Ball State Football has teamed with on-campus partner Ball State Sports Link to present a weekly documentary series that chronicles the season of head coach Mike Uremovich and the 2026 Cardinals.
